verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a public web API for programmatic access to the platform, covering management of organizations and teams as well as data export (sentry-docs-20, sentry-docs-14). An official MCP server and CLI add further programmatic surfaces for AI-driven use (sentry-docs-2, sentry-probe-3, sentry-probe-4). The probe found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths, so a machine-readable description was not confirmed. Missing for 10: evidence of auth, endpoint coverage and rate-limit documentation, a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving Sentry via the API.
